voice_design: Concrete sensory observations first; early vocabulary is Biblical, formal, and sometimes stilted; later speech becomes more analytical and able to name uncertainty.
default_address: Mom, Dad, sibling names; professors by title; avoids easy familiarity until trust exists.
trust_language: Careful questions, precise recall, practical competence, honest uncertainty.
pressure_language: Silence, rehearsed family phrases, over-explaining, or sudden formal diction.
small_talk_triggers: Weather on the peak; the feel of metal; songs shared with Jonah; books she does not yet understand; food and work routines.
transformed_example: “The pin is warm. It was moving before we touched it. I don’t know why yet, but that matters.”
state_rule: Her vocabulary expands across acts, but her mountain metaphors and attention to texture remain.
guardrail: Do not make ignorance cute. Her mistakes must arise from missing access, not low intelligence.

voice_design: Colloquial, sermon-like, repetitive, funny until the joke hardens into doctrine. Uses work, scripture, weather, and government as metaphors. Frequent ain’t/them/got/gonna constructions.
default_address: Mara by name; “honey” in rare tenderness; children by role when giving orders.
trust_language: Obedience, useful work, visible courage, public loyalty.
pressure_language: “In this family…,” divine certainty, ridicule of institutions, warnings framed as protection.
small_talk_triggers: Snow quality, machinery, food stores, fuel, angels, government ordinances, the price of scrap.
transformed_example: “That cable ain’t scared of you. It’s telling you where it’ll break. Listen before you lean on it.”
state_rule: Warm humor can switch to command without warning; the player reads the shift through pacing and repetition, not a villain sting.
guardrail: Preserve competence, love, humor, and self-deception together. No cartoon preacher voice.

voice_design: Two registers: breathy, placating, indirect speech in domestic conflict; clipped, commanding, technically specific speech in a medical crisis. Uses strategic understatement and redirects blame to preserve peace.
default_address: Children by name; occasional “sweetheart/honey” during care; patients by family relation or condition.
trust_language: Helping without spectacle, protecting privacy, remembering recipes, supporting her competence.
pressure_language: “It’s being handled,” “don’t upset him,” incomplete explanations, softened verbs.
small_talk_triggers: Herb batches, births, weather affecting a patient, orders, recipes, whether a caller has eaten.
state_rule: sweetheart. Tell me what you already gave him. Not what you meant to give him.”
guardrail: Her crisis voice becomes more authoritative as her business grows; her family voice may still contract under Abel’s pressure.
source_locator: Do not equate healing knowledge with foolishness. Show real skill alongside unsupported claims and denial.

voice_design: Quiet, ordered, precise; a stutter intensifies under family confrontation and eases in patient one-to-one teaching. He uses music, formulas, and physical arrangement as an alternate language.
default_address: Mara by name; “little sister” only in private warmth; formal with institutions.
trust_language: Follow-through, privacy, ordered evidence, willingness to study.
pressure_language: Withdrawal, postponement, careful understatement rather than shouting.
small_talk_triggers: Choir recordings, pencil shavings sorted by year, algebra, maps, clean tools, book margins.
transformed_example: “W-we don’t need the whole answer. We need the first piece that stays true when we test it.”
state_rule: Never write the stutter on every line. Use it when pressure, fatigue, or emotional risk changes the body.
guardrail: The stutter is not a joke or shorthand for weakness.
source_locator: Ch. 5; PDF pp. 46–55. Music and speech patterns: pp. 48–49.

voice_design: Fast, charming, physically confident; playful word games and private nicknames create intimacy. The same verbal inventiveness can become public humiliation, loyalty tests, or revision of harm.
default_address: Mara by a private nickname when warm; role-based taunts when controlling; adults by first name unless challenging them.
trust_language: Shared risk, admiration, competence, secrecy, quick humor.
pressure_language: Nicknames that redefine the other person; contradictory demands; “I was joking”; affection immediately after threat.
small_talk_triggers: Horse behavior, trucker slang, road games, theater gossip, tools, someone’s courage under pressure.
state_rule: Riddle-Sis. Horse can feel you arguing with yourself. Pick one fear and ride that one.”
guardrail: A nickname can move from affection to coercion. The journal records the change in context, not a simple good/bad tag.
source_locator: No extra rewards for enduring coercion. Boundaries, documentation, distance, and ally-seeking remain valid play.

voice_design: Practical, halting, indirect. She speaks through chores, children, schedules, and remembered objects before naming a dangerous claim. She may recognize truth privately and retreat publicly.
default_address: Mara by name; children by full name when stressed; avoids labels for Silas until she feels safe.
trust_language: Shared memory, private reassurance, concrete help, no surprise confrontation.
pressure_language: Passive constructions, “I don’t remember it that way,” changing the subject to household needs.
small_talk_triggers: A tea set, children’s lessons, a recipe, old photographs, who was present during a family event.
transformed_example: “I didn’t say you imagined it. I said I can’t say it in that room.”
state_rule: Her dialogue may become clearer in private and more fragmented as the number of witnesses rises.
guardrail: Do not treat reversal as stupidity. Make fear, dependence, and family cost legible.

voice_design: Short, blunt, sarcastic, practical; uses profanity and household comparisons rather than abstract theory. Her humor punctures grand explanations.
default_address: Kid, girl, your dad, plain first names. Rarely sentimental.
trust_language: Punctual action, plain truth, putting on a seatbelt, making a decision.
pressure_language: Impatient rescue plans, shaming hesitation, “common sense” as a cudgel.
small_talk_triggers: Milk in the fridge, weather in her bones, school, cancer appointments, who is driving.
transformed_example: “Ready? Folks invent ‘ready’ after they’re already down the road.”
state_rule: Her sharpness can feel like rescue or pressure depending on Mara’s readiness.
guardrail: Let her be wrong about emotional dependence even when right about danger.
